# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Vulkan, performance, and platform reach**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0-unreleased adds Vulkan via Silk.NET, fixes a memory leak, and broadens containerized platform support. A new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package brings hardware-accelerated Vulkan rendering on Android and Linux. A CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in the SKImage raster failure path is fixed. Performance improvements land in SKRuntimeEffectUniforms and SKTextBlob text encoding. Community contributor @jeffska adds FreeType-based font support for Nano Server.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **chrome/m151 upstream bug fixes merged** — Stability and correctness patches from the Skia team's chrome/m151 branch have been merged, keeping the bundled engine current with upstream. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## Bug Fixes

- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak fixed in SKImage raster failure path** — When SKImage.Create failed to create a raster image, the CoTaskMem-allocated pixel buffer was not freed. The leak has been fixed. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Managed-code performance improvements in hot paths** — GetEncodedText avoids an intermediate string allocation in its null-terminated path, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its uniform lookup map to the known count, reducing allocations on the hot path. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package for hardware-accelerated Vulkan rendering** — A new package integrates Vulkan via the Silk.NET bindings, enabling GPU-accelerated rendering on Android and Linux. Vulkan visual tests now run on both platforms in CI. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **FreeType font support on Nano Server** — SkiaSharp now uses FreeType for font rendering on Windows Nano Server, resolving a long-standing limitation where fonts were unavailable in that container environment. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Containerized CI test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server** — New Docker-based CI legs validate SkiaSharp on Azure Linux, Alpine Linux (musl libc), and Windows Nano Server, broadening the set of supported container environments. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
